newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weak, except sturdy fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weak, except sturdy fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Monday, except fuel oil which was steady to firm, dealers said.
Gas oil fell $3.75 a tonne on futures but stronger demand boosted low sulphur diesel cargo premiums and a U.S. arb for Russians closed.
Gasoline fell sharply as U.K. and German demand has dried up ahead of Tuesday's U.K. budget, and crude fell.
Naphtha fell slightly tracking crude, but traders said the open arbitrage to the U.S. was supportive.
